title: Sexual Response Cycle
summary: The sexual response cycle is a model of how the body responds to sexual stimulation, usually described as desire, arousal (excitement), plateau, orgasm and resolution.
key_points: Real experiences don't always follow the stages in order, and orgasm isn't required for sex to be good.
After orgasm, many people with a penis have a refractory period before they can get aroused again.
